                                                           │   // Climb sums up the ascent of a smoothed profile in
                                                           │ meters: the raw
                                                           │   // altitude of the last segment jumps, so the series is
                                                           │ smoothed first.
                                                           │   func Climb(profile []float64) float64 {
                                                           │       smooth := smoothElevation(profile, 5)
                                                           │       var up float64
                                                           │       for i := 1; i < len(smooth); i++ {
                                                           │           if d := smooth[i] - smooth[i-1]; d > 0 {
                                                           │               up += d
                                                           │           }
                                                           │       }
                                                           │       return up
                                                           │   }
